topic: Total fuel cost for a road trip based on miles per gallon and gas price
core_question: A car gets 25 miles per gallon and gas costs $4 per gallon. Find the fuel cost for a 200-mile trip. (secondary: A cookie recipe makes 12 cookies using 1.5 cups of butter. How many cups of butter are needed to make 20 cookies?)
answer_summary: the total of $32 (200-mile trip at 25 mpg and $4 per gallon); after the topic shift: 2.5 cups of butter (scaling 1.5 cups from 12 to 20 cookies)
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there
